checks: Six grant states use one responsive DOM with unique consent IDs and no invented connection operations
Narrow sends exactly the retained permissions, no owner, and cannot offer a removed ability back
Explicit expiry and removal retain the existing endpoint/body, scopes and record boundary
Named revoke confirmation cancels without a write and preserves reason/context after a failed attempt
Pending review keeps all/no-end defaults and boundary/label choices; replacement approval never activates the old ID
Closed reapproval is reachable in one row action and preserves chosen partial permissions
Expired renewal changes only the existing end-date action, retaining its one chosen permission
Closed Remove remains a direct existing action; other connections and their work stay present
Provider key masking/save/test retain legacy storage and model-list endpoint with an invented intercepted credential
Every model remains available and privacy preference persists without promising a bypass or an unimplemented redaction effect
Admin preference retains confirmation/warnings/cancel/disable and the modal close target is44px
Key mint retains preset/body and one-time secret, honest clipboard fallback and explicit dismissal
Suspend is confirmed, ACK state survives a failed read, retry works and Reactivate remains direct
Key revoke is named/confirmed and keeps the exact DELETE endpoint
Operator counts filter their actual current-vault rows; stale evidence and full recorded scopes remain reachable
A filtered-away key returns keyboard focus to the ledger heading; replaced action buttons return focus to their row
All four surfaces and in-place editors fit1440/1280/390/320px with desktop comparison/mobile dossiers and dark phones
note: All API/provider requests fulfilled with invented data. Client wiring only; no real keys, grants, provider charges or backend acceptance.
